cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Congratulate Through Your Teeth
cards.instruction: Perform warm praise while allowing competitive resentment to intensify beneath every compliment.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Congratulations on the prize. Such a lovely year for forgiving judges.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Are you saying I didn't deserve it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. I'm saying they saw past things I couldn't.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That isn't much of a compliment.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then admire how hard I'm working to make it one.

mechanism: A congratulates its former poetry pupil on beating A while using correction and claims of original tuition to smuggle increasing resentment into praise.
confusable: Not open insult only: A keeps performing congratulations while undermining the prize through technical faults and indebtedness.
comparison: Creative competition win versus promotion over former trainer.
seedUse: D213 prize/forgiving judges/not deserved/compliment; S05 poetry rhythm coaching.
